title: feat(cell-cutting): refute five evenness mechanism routes at the interface
science: Cycle 788: refutation certificates for FIVE candidate mechanisms for interface evenness, one exact incidence transport identity with a rank obstruction, one boundary-frame determinacy theorem, and the within-fiber exchange distance law. The wall stands but the region where a mechanism can live is narrowed to a named six-dimensional letter-functional quotient invisible to the tetra incidence. Also
carried_by: The wall it defines is attacked with strictly stronger tools by #6363 (free fold reduction, full-group rigidity), #6367, #6369 and finally #6370, which collapses all 48 fiber instances to a single can
